descriptions.d16c_payload_attach_800e9b88: Resolve the owner's team, load the NULL resource into the primary (+200) and secondary (+204) handles, register both with the sink (+32) via virtual slot +92 using the team's values (+240, +408); if neither registration fails, create and retain the label service, attach it to the manager with the configured layer (result to +196), and initialise it with a copy of the team name (+412), the team code (+406), 0 and 1.
